title: Run and recover the minimal accountable producer-reviewer session
goal: Connect the W1 services into an accountable initial session and experimental fixed-workflow baseline, preserving the authority and recovery needed for later genuine agent initiative.
scope: Implement Dispatcher.run call ordering: readiness/budget, admitted intake, fixed visible checks, method/plan, ledger/progress, candidate admission, invocation completion, result submission, verification/review, finalization and delivery. Business rules remain in the owning services and strategies.

Wake on invocation completion and lease expiry, stop when required criteria are Satisfied or the A13 no-running/no-useful-work/verification-cost condition applies, and route typed failures to diagnosis. Keep the later board/consequence wakeup extension explicit without fake active behavior.

Expose trusted application start/interrupt/read/recover operations over recorded state. User stop stops autonomous admissions and requests cancellation; a grant/notice cannot impersonate the user. Preserve task, commitments/results, spent/held amounts, receipts and scoped holds; reattach/observe unresolved work without duplicate starts, settlement, budget reset or revived grants. Handle concurrent/duplicate controls without starving stop behind unrelated journal writes.

Compose and audit reports for Delivered/Blocked/Cancelled, using zero-call DeterministicReport after user stop and no final review/learning without continuation authority. Only Delivered sessions can schedule learning within unprotected budget. Build the new Application/Dispatcher entry point and a real-filesystem Scripted scenario; exact control names/types are implementation choices.
acceptance: One executable/runtime scenario proceeds from goal to producer, exact ResultVersion, independent review, ledger, final aggregate check and ReportDelivered, with attributable decisions and reconciled receipts for planning, production, review and narration.

A failing applicable check defeats approval; unavailable final reviewer produces Blocked(final_review_pending); insufficient verification capacity preserves work and explains unmet criteria. No case declares success because the provider exited normally.

Interrupt/reopen amid execution or reporting preserves committed work/accounting and does not repeat native starts, settlement or report delivery. A stopped session starts no final-review/narrator/learning call, unresolved effects block only conflicting scopes, and repeated unrelated events cannot starve user stop. The session runs over MemoryJournal and SqliteJournal.

The complete producer/reviewer session connects real A7 artifact acceptance to P2 discharge and actual non-artifact completion to its own discharge. It never requires fabricated acceptance/provenance to demonstrate lifecycle completion.

Integrate the W1 fixed-workflow baseline from explicit intake through accountable production/review/report. W3 adds real initiative, voluntary allocation and dynamic coordination; no ready prior executable, parser or session engine is assumed.

§3.9/R-19/R-20 require scoped cessation/release, independent settlement, no duplicate unresolved start, preserved budgets/history and effective user stop handling. Choose minimal concrete observation/control forms. After stop no new model call runs without applicable continuation authority.

Integration boundary confirmed by W1-0012 review: ContributionPolicy can select Verify/Diagnose with an exact ResultVersion subject, but P2 projected_completion currently connects typed non-artifact ResultVersion completion only for Review. ExecutionHost completion of ordinary candidate-scoped Verify/Diagnose therefore returns commitment_basis and does not discharge responsibility. W1-0012 AddVerifier uses the supported Research/Researcher subject=None path with exact refs in context. Connect those remaining ordinary forms through their real host/receipt/cessation consumer here; do not fabricate ArtifactAccepted or bypass original contribution scope. See ymp-docs/progress-implementation.md and crates/ymp-kernel/src/arbiter/lifecycle.rs.

W1-0013 completion and pre-integration read identified the ordinary candidate-review seam: AcceptanceAuthority.review currently consumes an active GrantToken. Host completion revokes that grant, so a completed paid Reviewer cannot use that API afterwards. Add a narrow consumer of its exact retained Completed/settled/closed output, original Assignment, ResultVersion and criteria; preserve historical ReviewRecorded shapes/references and never revive a grant. The W1-0013 candidate fixture records its active-grant review before executing that reviewer; its separately paid FinalReview consumer does not fill this ordinary-review seam.

Current ContributionPolicy selects Verify/Diagnose/DesignChecks for a retained candidate, not Review. The fixed A1 workflow must explicitly admit independent candidate review and connect Review -> A7 -> producer P2 before final aggregate capture; A8 Satisfied alone is not an accepted source. Keep that required call ordering outside strategy claims and do not accept a normal provider exit as artifact acceptance.

Recovery/control seams confirmed by read-only preparation: new Application/DecisionConsumer and Treasury cannot yet recover original SessionControl/BudgetControl; completed retained production cannot be submitted after losing PreparedAttempt/issuer; Host.recover only observes unresolved work and must not duplicate it. Implement trusted continuation from recorded facts without new grants or budget reset. MemoryJournal currently has no binding_identity/workspace_binding, so its full Direct scenario needs an honest in-memory identity/binding implementation instead of bypassing WorkspaceGuard. Durable owner stop needs atomic current-revision ordering or equivalent evidence of no starvation; repeated optimistic CAS retries alone are insufficient. Preserve Host.cancel immediate local stopped flag and mediated withdrawal even when journal writes fail.
